# Statement lifecycle + bind semantics — oracle transcript (UCL U1/U2)

`transcript.jsonl` is generated by `tools/oracle_c/stmtbind_oracle.c`, a
scratch C program driving the system SQLite C API (`sqlite3_prepare_v2`,
`sqlite3_bind_*`, `sqlite3_step`, `sqlite3_reset`, `sqlite3_clear_bindings`,
`sqlite3_finalize`, `sqlite3_close`) on an in-memory database. It records the
ground-truth behavior of prepared-statement parameter metadata, bind
range/MISUSE errors, typeof preservation through typed binds, embedded-NUL
text binds, clear_bindings, double-step MISUSE, and close-with-unfinalized
BUSY.

Regenerate:

    cc -o /tmp/stmtbind tools/oracle_c/stmtbind_oracle.c -lsqlite3
    /tmp/stmtbind   # writes transcript.jsonl to cwd

Expectations consumed by `TestStmtBindConformance` (frigolite root package).
The oracle build reports MAX_VARIABLE_NUMBER=500000; frigolite's engine
constant and every derived expectation in tests use the value the transpiler
emits for $SQLITE_MAX_VARIABLE_NUMBER.
